text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Respiratory distress. I also have Tachypnea, Subcostal and intercostal retractions, Nasal flaring, Cyanosis.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: The mother had gestational diabetes. No other significant family or prenatal history. Social history: Not applicable

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: The cyanosis improving with oxygen and lack of prior feeding difficulties are helpful clues. To determine the cause of the distress, I need to know if your mother had any specific infections during pregnancy or required a C-section delivery. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray, REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Ground-glass appearance, air bronchograms, suggesting Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS); Complete_Blood_Count: Normal for age.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the chest X-ray showing ground-glass opacities and air bronchograms, which are classic signs of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS), I need to confirm the severity of hypoxia and acidosis. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas. REQUEST TEST: Pulse_Oximetry. Did your mother have pre-existing diabetes or Gestational Diabetes Mellitus?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Arterial_Blood_Gas: pH 7.30, PaCO2 50 mm Hg, PaO2 60 mm Hg, HCO3- 24 mEq/L, Base_Excess -5; Pulse_Oximetry: 88% on room air, improving with oxygen. The mother had Gestational Diabetes Mellitus.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The A-BG confirms respiratory acidosis with hypoxemia, and the mother's history of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus is a major risk factor for a macrosomic infant with transient tachypnea. Given the ground-glass opacities on the X-ray, I need to know your gestational age to distinguish between Respiratory Distress Syndrome and Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn.

REQUEST TEST: Gestational_Age_Assessment
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray_Review
